title: Undertaker Bell
blurb: One gong, and twenty thousand people go quiet. The Undertaker's funeral toll froze arenas for three decades, and it managed that through pure restraint — no music yet, no lights, just a single bell announcing that somebody's evening has been decided for them. The effect transfers to a group chat with remarkable fidelity. Play it when a terrible decision is announced, when somebody is called into a meeting with HR, or when a message arrives consisting of a single full stop. Doom, ceremonially delivered, entirely without hurry.
origin: The entrance gong of WWE's The Undertaker.
